name: half-hour-throttle-intermediate-reversion
rationale: Every throttle variant since 2026-09-21 improved Sharpe and drawdown at all three capitals but failed only the >=50% trade-count criterion (1h/1h kept 17% on 2026-10-01). This is the mildest diagonal throttle not yet tried (1800s block, 1800s spacing), paired with the rsi 60 / bollinger 90 horizons that drove the 2026-10-01 static-mix-beating result, aiming to keep a promotable trade count at 50,000 JPY while still cutting turnover. Score on total_fees_jpy, not trade count; caveat that at 50,000 JPY a block throttle can be anti-throttling (2026-09-21 signal_block_secs measurement).
